name: Assembl
tagline: Enterprise administration for the modern multi-site ministry
positioning: Assembl unifies membership, giving, scheduling, and compliance for large congregations and multi-campus denominations on one governed platform.

hero.h1: The governed operating system for large-scale ministry
hero.sub: Assembl consolidates membership records, contribution processing, facility scheduling, and denominational reporting into a single auditable platform built for multi-campus organizations.

features.title: Unified member directory
features.description: Reconcile household records across every campus with deduplication, role-based access, and a full audit trail on every field change.

features.title: Contribution processing
features.description: Reconcile online, kiosk, and envelope giving nightly, then generate IRS-ready annual statements without exporting to spreadsheets.

features.title: Facility & event scheduling
features.description: Route room requests, resource conflicts, and volunteer staffing through an approval workflow your operations team actually controls.

features.title: Denominational reporting
features.description: Roll campus metrics into board-ready statistical reports that satisfy diocesan and denominational filing requirements on schedule.

features.title: Governance & controls
features.description: Enforce SSO, granular permissions, and retention policies with SOC 2 Type II attestation and configurable data residency.

features.title: Volunteer coordination
features.description: Manage background-check status, ministry team rosters, and serving schedules across thousands of active volunteers.

testimonials.quote: We retired four disconnected systems the quarter we deployed Assembl. Our finance close now takes three days instead of three weeks, and every contribution is fully reconciled.
testimonials.name: Rebecca Holloway

testimonials.quote: Managing eleven campuses meant eleven versions of the truth. Assembl gave our leadership a single governed record and reporting our board finally trusts.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: The audit trail alone justified the investment. When our denomination requested three years of statistical filings, we produced them in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Marianne Vogel
